# Comfy Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash- Video Edit

Edit videos through natural language conversation with Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash. Upload a clip (10 seconds or less) and describe the change: swap backgrounds, restyle scenes, add or remove elements, and the model applies the edit while preserving everything you did not mention. Add \"Keep everything else the same\" for maximum consistency; simple prompts work best. Outputs video with native audio at 16:9 or 9:16, with 1080p/4K output available. Ideal for remixes, style changes, and iterative refinement without re-generating from scratch. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Change the character in the video to a walking human‑shaped cactus
